newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain's share index reaches new high.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's share index reaches new high.

text.p: Bahrain's share index climbed to a new record high on Wednesday in active trade dominated by Bahrain International Bank (BIB) shares, official figures showed.
The Bahrain Stock Exchange (BSE) said the index rose 37.15 points on Wednesday to 1,456.69 points after rising 25.58 points on Tuesday in brisk trade.
More than eight million shares worth 1.42 million dinars ($3.77 million) were traded in 107 transactions, up from 5.82 million shares worth 1.1 million dinars on Tuesday.

The BSE said more than 3.2 million BIB shares changed hands on Wednesday. Share prices of the BIB, also traded on the Kuwait Stock Exchange, climbed to 145 fils per share, up eight fils from 137 fils on Tuesday.
The bourse said 2.4 million shares of Bahrain Middle East Bank (BMB) were also traded at 71 fils per share, up two fils from Tuesday.
